# Documentation & paperwork
The following forms should be available for use within Science:
- [bold]Mech Authorization Form[/bold]: Official documentation of mech construction, including the mech's class, authorized personnel, and reasoning for construction. - [bold]Borgification Consent Form[/bold]: Records explicit consent by crew member to be converted into a cyborg. - [bold]Cyborg Conversion Form[/bold]: Records individual to be converted, the new chassis, authorization, and reasoning. - [bold]Item Request Form[/bold]: documentation of upgrades, distributed boards, and recipients. - [bold]Anomalous Host Consent Form[/bold]: written informed consent for crew hosting anomalies. - [bold]Anomaly Research Log[/bold]: Documentation of anomaly research.
All forms should be filed promptly in departmental records and made available for review by the RD, Command, or Internal Affairs.
